D5/S3/Quantum/Measurement/Bloch/AxisCont.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Measurement.Bloch.axisContraction_commutator
D5/S3/Quantum/Measurement/Bloch/AxisCont.signature: theorem axisContraction_commutator (n m : Fin 3 → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) : axisContraction n c * axisContraction m d - axisContraction m d * axisContraction n c = ((1 - c) * (1 - d) * axisDot n m) • (axisOuter n m - axisOuter m n)

D5/S3/Quantum/Measurement/Bloch/AxisCont.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Measurement.Bloch.axisContraction_commutator_ne_zero_of_nonparallel_nonorthogonal
D5/S3/Quantum/Measurement/Bloch/AxisCont.signature: theorem axisContraction_commutator_ne_zero_of_nonparallel_nonorthogonal {n m : Fin 3 → ℝ} {c d : ℝ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hparallel : ¬ ∃ s : ℝ, m = s • n) (hdot : axisDot n m ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 1) (hd : d ≠ 1) : axisContraction n c * axisContraction m d - axisContraction m d * axisContraction n c ≠ 0

D5/S3/Quantum/Measurement/Bloch/AxisCont.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Measurement.Bloch.axisOuter_eq_implies_parallel
D5/S3/Quantum/Measurement/Bloch/AxisCont.signature: theorem axisOuter_eq_implies_parallel {n m : Fin 3 → ℝ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (h : axisOuter n m = axisOuter m n) : ∃ s : ℝ, m = s • n
